headline: Lithium Equities Slide as LIT Fund Drops 2.8% on Albemarle and SQM Losses
summary: The Global X Lithium ETF fell 2.79% to $60.94, weighed down by a 3.81% drop in Albemarle and a 4.36% decline in Chile's SQM during New York trading.
why: Albemarle and SQM are the world's leading lithium producers, functioning as critical suppliers to global electric vehicle and battery manufacturing supply chains.
